method: Measured on 2026-11-04 by pnpm perf:budgets --bytes --template astro: the Astro template built for production (astro build) and served by astro preview against a seeded API; each script request Lighthouse's mobile load of / makes is fetched again, and scriptBytes is the sum of gzip(body) at zlib's default level. astro preview does not compress, so the wire size is the raw size. 362 B over cfc530f (27,586 B): the shopper's session restored from the refresh cookie on every page load, in the client chunk every page imports (12,256 B to 12,602 B): the hold that keeps a page's first requests until the one refresh settles, the localStorage session hint that lets a guest's page send nothing, the token an earlier version kept in localStorage adopted into the hint, and the rule that forgets the session only when the API refuses the refresh. The auth store itself stays off every page that reads no profile. No other script on / changed.
rebaselined: 2026-11-09: 27,948 to 27,949, one byte for the order.note_added.v1 event name on every storefront; the page budget, 28,672, is unchanged. 2026-11-09: 27,949 to 28,008, 59 bytes for the search store's page origin and its guard against a repeated search, in the header search on every storefront; the budget is unchanged.
